gemini_prompt: Add each night on this flyer to my Sage Hall Dances calendar. Title: "Country Swing Dancing", or the event's name for special nights (like a fundraiser or club night). Location: exactly the venue name from the flyer, or leave it empty if there's no venue or it says TBD. Start at the time on the flyer. If no time is given, make it an all-day event; never guess a time. End at midnight for Fairgrounds and Mountain Valley Athletics nights, and 3 hours after the start for Cache Bar. Don't add anything that isn't on the flyer.
schedule_rules:
1. Make sure events are in the 'Sage Hall Dances' calendar, not a personal calendar.
2. Title regular nights 'Country Swing Dancing', or the event's name for a special night.
3. Put the venue name in Location, spelled as on the website (e.g. 'Fairgrounds Event Center', 'Fairgrounds Indoor Barn', 'Mountain Valley Athletics', 'Cache Bar').
4. Time TBA: make the event All day.
5. Location TBA: leave Location empty.
6. Cancel a night: start the title with 'Cancelled' (e.g. 'Cancelled: Country Swing Dancing') and use the Announcement banner in Site settings to explain why.
7. No dance night: start the title with 'No Dance' (e.g. 'No Dance - Happy Thanksgiving!').
8. Share calendar with staff: in Google Calendar settings for Sage Hall Dances → Share with specific people → Make changes to events.
